description: This file defines the EmployeeTrackerModel class, which models employee tracker data within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin API. It implements normalization and serialization traits, and maps data from PerformanceTracker entities to an API response schema, including employee details and timestamps.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerModel
classes.description: A model class representing employee tracker information for API serialization, including employee details and tracking timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a PerformanceTracker entity and sets up fields for serialization.
